capabilities: Replaces the new tab with a multi-page dashboard
Searches notes, tags and commands with global fuzzy search
Rearranges and resizes widgets by drag and drop
extras: Free and open-source (MIT) with no accounts, subscriptions or telemetry; all pages, widget settings, timers and habit records are stored in the vault's data.json, and settings can be exported/imported as JSON for backup or migration.
intentEvidence: Enhanced Homepage replaces Obsidian's blank new tab with a customizable workspace
motivation: The author wanted a complete dashboard out of the box instead of stitching together multiple plugins, custom Dataview queries, and fragile CSS snippets.
problem: Obsidian's new tab is blank, and assembling a homepage means combining several plugins, Dataview queries, and CSS that breaks on mobile.

relations.evidence: Displays your bookmarked files from Obsidian's core Bookmarks plugin

summary: Multi-page new-tab dashboard with 16 configurable widgets, global fuzzy search, wallpapers, and local-first storage.
